protocol.title: PE beads · Exp 03 · Flat field per objective and scan format
protocol.summary: Measure the illumination and collection fall-off across the field for each objective, zoom and frame size, every session.

children.body: Bead intensity depends on where the bead sits in the field until this correction is applied.
Pins: the vignetting map v(x, y). Corner-to-centre fall-off of 10 % or more is typical on point-scanning confocals, and up to 40–60 % at low zoom has been reported.

rows.free_text: The uniform sample from Exp 02 (plastic slide or dye chamber)

rows.value: Every objective × zoom × frame size you will use for beads
8, each after a 50 µm stage move (averages out dust and scratches)

children.body: Before any quantitative acquisition: stand and lasers on for 2–3 h; 561 nm excitation; the same PE emission band (e.g. 570–620 nm) every time; 16-bit with fine integration (the default is 12-bit, so check the file); one HV and one offset for the whole session; background mode at least 50 DN above zero; no saturated pixels. Record the transmitted-light channel with every PE frame: beads are found in it, never in PE. Find focus in transmitted light and hold it with Perfect Focus. Never live-scan PE to focus.
Field side assumes the FN 25 field is a square inscribed in a 25 mm circle (17.7 mm at the intermediate image). Check it once with a stage micrometer.
Focus 20 µm into the dye (or onto the slide) by transmitted light; turn Perfect Focus on.
For each combination, take 8 frames with a 50 µm stage move between them.
Take 10 dark frames (laser 0 %) with the same settings.
Median-combine the 8 frames, subtract the dark mean, smooth lightly (Gaussian, 2–3 px) and divide by the mean of the central 10 % of the field. That is the flat field FF(x, y).
Corrected image = (raw − offset) / FF. Report the corner-to-centre ratio.
Mark the region where 1/FF is below 1.25; analyse beads only inside it, or report the residual bias.
Decision: the analysable region per objective and scan format, and the FF image used for every bead image of that session.

rows.note: Name of the saved FF image

children.body: Save the .nd2 files as acquired (no 8-bit export, no LUT) in a folder outside the website repo, e.g. BeadConfocalData/<date>_<exp>/, and fill one plate-map CSV row per well or field (columns are listed in Research/PE_bead_confocal_experiments.md, section 7).
